checks.scope_and_limits: Claims are correctly restricted to descriptive scores: no alpha, performance, causality or superiority claim is made; direction +1 is labeled a hypothesis given sign-divergent means (-0.0066, +0.0052, +0.0027); unadjusted non-vintage closes and corporate-action non-identifiability are disclosed. The 'comparable as simple returns' statement asserts only dimensionless common scale, not improved comparability, and dispersion differences are documented as a limitation.
checks.spec_and_prose: Spec conforms to allowed_spec_schema (all five keys, values in range). The expression 1*(close[t]/close[t-5]-1) matches spec lookback=5, direction=1, normalization none; signal_rule and availability/execution rules are internally consistent and use only observations at/before t with execution at next observed close. Rationale correctly treats every finding as descriptive and disposes of all four; the reject of normalization is justified since no forward labels exist to show improvement.
checks.timing: Availability uses only closes at or before t and execution is no earlier than the next observed close after t; 53 of 54 signals per symbol have a next observed close and the last-row signal is explicitly excluded from any execution claim. No lookahead found.
